      Volunteer activity

      My Availability

      Every week

      Times you’re always busy, like work. They repeat every week.

      One-off

      A single day or time you’re busy.

      While you’re busy or on holiday, you won’t get availability alerts and the admins see you as not available. You can still answer a request if you’re able to help.

      Website Topics

      Advice pages on the website, for example Fireworks or Stormy weather. They show under “Advice & seasonal tips” on the home page.

      Open the website

      Add a topic

      Start a line with # for a heading (each heading gets its own box), and with - for a bullet point. Put words between ** to make them bold. Web links work as they are.

      Post it on our Facebook Page first, then copy its link and paste it here. Pick which heading each one shows under; you can put several under the same heading. Videos and reels play on the website; a Facebook post (e.g. our fireworks post) shows with its picture and text. The post must be public.
      Getting the right link: the iPhone’s Share → Copy link gives a share link (with /share/ in it), and Facebook won’t show those on our website. Instead, on a computer: open the post or reel on Facebook (or open the share link), click its date, then copy the address from the top of the browser. It should look like facebook.com/reel/… or facebook.com/LostDogsAyrshire/posts/…

      Access & Roles

        Create Lost Dog Poster

        Fill in the details and the poster is made for you.

        Posts the square poster with ready-written text to the Page. You check it first.

        The watermark is added to the photo automatically.

        Add a poster

        If the wording needs a place typed in each time, tap the button to put [location] where the place should go. People are then asked for it before they copy.

        Signed forms

        My Profile

        Where I am based

        Choose the town or village you would normally set off from. This helps the team see who is closest when a dog goes missing.

        Now tap the map roughly where that is. The middle of the village is close enough; it does not need to be your home.

        No pin placed yet. Tap the map.

        Your postcode lets the team see who really is closest to a missing dog. We only keep the first part (e.g. KA1 2) and a rough spot for that area, never your full postcode or address. Only admins can see it.

        My equipment

        Tell us what search equipment you have. Pick each item from the lists, then add its serial number. Leave this empty if you have none.

        Only you and the admin team can see your profile. We keep your town or village, not your address. You can change it at any time.

        Volunteer Agreement

        Read the full agreement
        Volunteer Agreement & Liability Disclaimer

        Organization Name: LOST DOGS AYRSHIRE
        Purpose: Missing Dog Search & Rescue Support

        Important Notice
        This agreement is binding in honour only. It is a statement of our shared intent and values. It is not intended to be a legally binding contract of employment, and no employment relationship is created between the volunteer and the group.

        1. Voluntary Participation & Physical Health

        • I understand that participating in outdoor search operations is completely voluntary.
        • I confirm that I am physically fit enough to undertake outdoor search activities, which may involve walking on uneven terrain, in poor weather conditions, or during low-light hours.
        • I accept sole responsibility for managing my own health, stamina, and any pre-existing medical conditions during an active search.
        • Under 18s: If I am under the age of 18, I must be accompanied at all times by a parent or legal guardian who must also sign this agreement on my behalf.

        2. Assumption of Risk & Liability

        • I acknowledge that searching for missing dogs carries inherent physical risks. These include, but are not limited to: slips, trips, and falls; exposure to extreme weather; traffic hazards; and potential injuries or bites from frightened or defensive animals.
        • I agree that LOST DOGS AYRSHIRE, its founders, and its coordinators are not liable for any personal injury, illness, medical emergencies, or loss/damage to my personal property sustained while volunteering.

        3. Operational Safety & Conduct Rules

        • I agree to follow all safety briefings, search protocols, and instructions given by the designated search coordinators.
        • I will prioritize my personal safety and the safety of the public at all times. If I feel a situation or terrain is unsafe, I will withdraw and notify the coordinator immediately.
        • I will use the “Buddy System” and will never conduct a field or night search completely alone.
        • I will wear appropriate footwear and high-visibility clothing, and carry necessary personal safety gear (e.g., a torch and a fully charged mobile phone) as advised.
        • I will respect local laws and will not trespass on private property without explicit permission from landowners or search coordinators.

        4. Handling & Approaching Animals

        • I understand that missing dogs are frequently in “survival mode” and may react with panic, flight, or aggression.
        • I agree not to chase, corner, lure aggressively, or shout at a missing dog, as this can drive them into further danger (such as roads). I will strictly follow the group’s protocol regarding sightings and containment.

        5. Use of Private Vehicles

        • I confirm that if I use my own vehicle for volunteer activities (such as traveling to search sites or transporting gear), it is fully roadworthy, taxed, and has a valid MOT.
        • I accept sole responsibility for ensuring my motor insurance policy covers volunteer driving. (Note: Most UK insurers cover volunteer driving at no extra cost, but it is your responsibility to verify this with your provider).
        • I agree to comply with all UK driving laws. I accept that LOST DOGS AYRSHIRE accepts no liability for parking fines, traffic penalties, vehicle damage, or theft incurred during volunteering.

        6. Care of Loaned Equipment

        • I agree to look after any equipment loaned to me by the group (e.g., thermal equipment, microchip scanners, trail cameras, traps, walkie-talkies, uniforms) and use it only for its intended purpose.
        • I will report any damage, malfunction, or loss of the equipment to a search coordinator as soon as possible.
        • I agree to return all loaned items promptly upon request, or immediately if I step down from my volunteer role.

        7. Confidentiality, Privacy & Media

        • I agree to keep sensitive information regarding missing animal owners, home addresses, or ongoing search operations private.
        • I will not post specific search locations, live tracking coordinates, or sensitive updates on my personal social media accounts unless explicitly authorized by the search coordinator.

        8. Data Protection (UK GDPR)

        • I consent to LOST DOGS AYRSHIRE holding my name, contact details, and emergency contact info for operational and safety purposes. This data will be stored securely and will never be shared with third parties without my consent.

        Volunteer Declaration & Sign-off

        By signing below, I confirm that I have read, understood, and agree to the terms of this volunteer disclaimer.
